questarr.name: Questarr
questarr.description: Video game management application inspired by the *Arr apps. Discover, track and automatically download the games you want.
questarr.longDescription: Questarr is a video game management application inspired by the *Arr apps (Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr). Track your collection with status indicators, discover new releases through IGDB, RSS feeds and xREL, sync your Steam wishlist, search your Torznab/Newznab indexers, and send releases straight to qBittorrent, Transmission, rTorrent, Deluge, Synology Download Station, SABnzbd or NZBGet.
